if not you-f-will-know to/for-you-f, the-beautiful in-the-womans ; exit to/for-you-f in-heels-of the-flock and-pasture kids-of-you-f, on tabernacles-of the-pasturing.

beloved-of-me to/for-me and-I to/for-him, the-pasturing in-the-lilies.

silver, has-done pillars-of-him, back-of-him gold, chariot-of-him purple ; midst-of-him fited love, from-daughters-of Jerusalem.
exit and-see daughters-of Zion in-the-king Solomon ; in-the-crown mother-of-him that-has-crowned to/for-him in-day-of marriage-of-him, and-in-day-of joy-of heart-of-him.

all-of-you-f beautiful darling-of-me, and-blemish naught in-you-f.
with-me from-Lebanon daughter-in-law, with-me from-Lebanon let-come ; you-f-will-see from-head-of Amana from-head-of Senir and-Hermon, from-habitations-of lions, from-mountains-of leopards.

what beloveds-of-you-f have-beautifuled sister-of-me daughter-in-law ; what beloveds-of-you-f have-pleasinged from-wine, and-aroma-of oils-of-you-f from-all-of spices.
lipses-of-you-f will-drip honey, daughter-in-law ; honey and-milk under tongue-of-you-f, and-aroma-of garments-of-you-f like-aroma-of Lebanon.
garden locked sister-of-me daughter-in-law ; heap locked spring sealed.
missiles-of-you-f park-of pomegranates, with fruit-of excellences ; hennas with nards.
nard and-saffron branch and-cinnamon, with all-of trees-of frankincense ; myrrh and-aloes, with all-of heads-of spices.
spring-of gardens, well-of waters living ; and-flowing from Lebanon.
rouse north and-come south, make-breathe spices-of-him ; let-flow garden-of-me beloved-of-me let-come to/for-garden-of-him, and-let-eat fruit-of excellences-of-him.

I-have-come to/for-garden-of-me sister-of-me daughter-in-law I-have-plucked myrrh-of-me with spice-of-me, I-have-eaten honeycomb-of-me with honey-of-me, I-have-drunk wine-of-me with milk-of-me ; eat neighbors, drink and-drunk beloveds.
I sleeping and-heart-of-me rousing ; voice-of beloved-of-me beating open to/for-me sister-of-me darling-of-me dove-of-me complete-of-me, that-head-of-me filled dew, locks-of-me drops-of night.
I-have-striped tunic-of-me, how I-will-clothe-her ; I-have-washed foots-of-me how I-will-soil-them.
beloved-of-me has-sended hand-of-him from the-hole, and-bellies-of-me have-roared on-him.
I have-risen to/for-open to/for-beloved-of-me ; and-hands-of-me have-driped myrrh and-fingers-of-me myrrh passing, on palms-of the-bolt.

I have-opened to/for-beloved-of-me, and-beloved-of-me has-awayed has-passed ; soul-of-me has-exited in-speak-of-him, I-have-sought-him and-not I-have-found-him, I-have-called-him and-not has-answered-me.
they-have-found-me the-keeping the-turning in-the-city they-have-made-smite-me they-have-wounded-me ; have-lifted veil-of-me on-me, keeping-of the-walls.
I-have-made-swear you-pl daughters-of Jerusalem ; if you-pl-will-find beloved-of-me, what you-pl-will-make-announce to/for-him, that-weaking-of love I.
what beloved-of-you-f from-beloved, the-beautiful in-the-womans ; what beloved-of-you-f from-beloved, that-thus you-f-have-made-swear-us.
beloved-of-me dazzling and-red, looked from-myriad.
head-of-him gold-of pure ; locks-of-him locks, black like-the-raven.
eyes-of-him, like-doves on channels-of waters ; washing in-the-milk, dwelling on setting.
Lehi-of-him like-bed-of the-spice, towers-of spices ; lipses-of-him lilies, driping myrrh passing.
hands-of-him circuits-of gold, filled in-the-jasper ; bellies-of-him plate-of tooth, enwraped sapphires.
legs-of-him pillars-of alabaster, founded on sockets-of pure ; sight-of-him like-the-Lebanon, chosen like-the-cedars.
palate-of-him sweetnesses, and-all-of-him desires ; this beloved-of-me and-this neighbor-of-me, daughters-of Jerusalem.
where beloved-of-you-f the-beautiful has-gone, in-the-womans ; where beloved-of-you-f has-turned, and-we-will-seek-him with-you-f.
beloved-of-me has-gone to/for-garden-of-him, to/for-beds-of the-spice ; to/for-pasture in-the-gardens, and-to/for-gather lilies.
I to/for-beloved-of-me and-beloved-of-me to/for-me, the-pasturing in-the-lilies.
you beautiful darling-of-me like-Tirzah, lovely like-Jerusalem ; terrible like-the-set.
make-turn eyes-of-you-f before-me, they-them they-have-made-assertive-me ; hair-of-you-f like-flock-of the-goats, that-they-have-downed from the-Gilead.
tooths-of-you-f like-flock-of the-ewes, that-they-have-ascended from the-washing ; that-all-of-them doubles, and-childless naught in-them.
like-millstone-of the-pomegranate temple-of-you-f, about to/for-veil-of-you-f.
sixty they queens, and-eighty concubines ; and-maidens naught number.
one he dove-of-me complete-of-me, one he to/for-mother-of-her, pure he to/for-begeting-of-her ; daughters have-seen-her and-they-have-blessed-her, queens and-concubines and-they-have-boasted-her.
who this-f the-looked like dawn ; beautiful like-the-moon pure like-the-heat, terrible like-the-set.
toward garden-of nut I-have-gone, to/for-see in-greeneries-of the-torrent ; to/for-see the-vine the-has-sprouted, have-made-bud the-pomegranates.
not I-have-known, soul-of-me has-put-me, chariots-of people-of-me noble.
return return the-Shulammites, return return and-we-will-see in-you-f ; what you-pl-will-see in-the-Shulammites, like-dance-of the-camps.

two-of breasts-of-you-f like-two-of fawns twins-of gazelle.
neck-of-you-f like-tower-of the-tooth ; eyes-of-you-f pools in-Heshbon on gate-of Bat Rabiym, nose-of-you-f like-tower-of the-Lebanon, watching faces-of Damascus.
head-of-you-f on-you-f like-the-Carmel, and-hair-of head-of-you-f like-the-purple ; king binded in-the-locks.
what you-f-have-beautifuled and-what you-f-have-pleasanted, love in-the-luxuries.
this-f height-of-you-f has-resembled to/for-palm, and-breasts-of-you-f to/for-clusters.

and-palate-of-you-f, like-wine-of the-good going to/for-beloved-of-me to/for-uprightnesses ; gliding lipses-of sleep.
I to/for-beloved-of-me, and-on-me longing-of-him.

the-mandrakes have-given aroma and-on entrances-of-us all-of excellences, new also Haychana ; beloved-of-me I-have-treasured to/for-you-f.
who he-will-give-you like-brother to/for-me, suckling breasts-of mother-of-me ; I-will-find-you in-the-outside I-will-kiss-you, also not they-will-despise to/for-me.

left-of-him under head-of-me, and-right-of-him will-embrace-me.

put-me like-the-signet on heart-of-you like-the-signet on arm-of-you, for strong like-the-death love, severe like-hell jealousy ; flashes-of-her, flashes-of, fire flame LORD.
waters many not will-able to/for-quench the-love, and-rivers not will-overflow-her ; if man will-give all-of substance-of house-of-him in-the-love, despise they-will-despise to/for-him.
sister to/for-us small, and-breasts naught to/for-her ; what we-will-do to/for-sister-of-us, in-the-day that-he-will-speak in-her.
if wall he, we-will-build on-her encampment-of silver ; and-if door he, we-will-confine on-her tablet-of cedar.
I wall, and-breasts-of-me like-the-towers ; then I-have-been in-eyes-of-him like-making-find peace.

vineyard-of-me that-to/for-me to/for-faces-of-me ; the-thousand to/for-you Solomon, and-hundred to/for-keeping fruit-of-him.
the-dwelling in-the-gardens companions making-heed to/for-voice-of-you-f make-hear-me.
flee beloved-of-me and-resemble to/for-you to/for-gazelle or to/for-fawn-of the-deers, on mountains-of spices.
